IbmConnectionOut.description:
The user's IBM connection as GET and PUT /v1/account/ibm-connection show it.

`status` is active, or invalid once IBM refused the token or instance while a
job ran. `token_last4` is the only part of the token ever shown, and the
CRN is never returned. `backends` are the devices the instance could use when
it was last checked (`validated_at`).
IbmConnectionOut.title: IbmConnectionOut

description:
GET and PUT /v1/account/ibm-connection response: always 200, never 404.

`connection` is null when the user has no own connection. `default_source` is
what the user's IBM jobs run on without one: "organization" (an IBM account
EigenOrbit provides, by the user's stored email domain) or "none" (IBM jobs
are refused). `in_flight_jobs` counts the user's own-source jobs in held,
submitting, submitted or running: the jobs a replace or disconnect cancels.
title: IbmConnectionStateOut
